## English

### Device connections

- When the same online Android device connects through both an IP address and wireless discovery, ADM shows one entry. Its name and device actions apply to the grouped connections.
- Right-click a connected network device and choose **Disconnect** to end its ADB connection.

### Device control

- On x86_64 devices running Android 6.0 or later, ADM automatically switches to an in-process H.264 encoder if the system video encoder fails. The control session stays open.
- Compatibility mode supports up to 1280 pixels on the long edge at 30 FPS. Once it works, ADM remembers the mode for that ADB connection until ADM exits or the device reconnects.

## 简体中文

### 设备连接

- 同一台在线设备同时通过 IP 地址和无线发现连接时，列表只显示一项。备注名称和设备操作会应用到这组连接。
- 右键点击已连接的网络设备，选择「断开连接」即可结束 ADB 连接。

### 控制设备

- 在 Android 6.0 及以上的 x86_64 设备上，系统视频编码器故障时，ADM 会在当前控制会话内自动切换至 H.264 兼容编码。
- 兼容模式最高支持长边 1280 像素、30 FPS。首次成功后，ADM 会记住当前 ADB 连接的编码模式，直到退出 ADM 或设备重新建立连接。
